1	/**
2	 * R2-backed RunLogStore for Cloudflare Workers.
3	 *
4	 * Design notes:
5	 * - R2 objects are immutable after a PUT. "Append" semantics are implemented
6	 *   by reading the existing object, concatenating the new line, and re-PUTing.
7	 *   For very large logs, key sharding is used: each chunk beyond the first
8	 *   CHUNK_BYTE_LIMIT is written to a new shard key
9	 *   `runs/<companyId>/<agentId>/<runId>/chunk-<n>.ndjson`.
10	 * - All APIs are Web-platform only (fetch, TextEncoder/Decoder, SubtleCrypto,
11	 *   ReadableStream). No `node:fs`, `node:stream`, or `node:crypto`.
12	 * - The `logRef` stored in RunLogHandle is the base key prefix
13	 *   `runs/<companyId>/<agentId>/<runId>` so callers treat it as opaque.
14	 */
15	
16	import type {
17	  RunLogHandle,
18	  RunLogReadOptions,
19	  RunLogReadResult,
20	  RunLogFinalizeSummary,
21	  RunLogStore,
22	} from "../../../../server/src/services/run-log-store.js";
23	
24	export type { RunLogHandle, RunLogReadOptions, RunLogReadResult, RunLogFinalizeSummary, RunLogStore };
25	
26	/** Maximum bytes buffered in a single R2 object before spilling to a new shard. */
27	const CHUNK_BYTE_LIMIT = 128 * 1024; // 128 KiB
28	
29	/** Default read window when no limitBytes is specified. */
30	const DEFAULT_READ_LIMIT = 256_000;
